lint.command: pnpm exec eslint packages/protocol/src --max-warnings=0 && pnpm exec biome check packages/protocol/src

inputs.comment: The public-schema fixture guard READS this variable and, when it is set, REWRITES every fixture instead of comparing against them. A run with it set and a run without it are two different tasks, and without this input the cache answered the second with the first — which is how a fixture regeneration ended up needing --skip-nx-cache. Named specifically (CLAUDE.md: a target that reads an environment variable names only the load-bearing ones).
